_comment: 创伤知情教育模拟，依据刑法、刑事诉讼法及用户提供的8份强制猥亵裁判文书抽象重构。仅使用证据结构与程序经验，不出现姓名或可识别细节；具体程序因地区、医疗机构与案情而异，全部文本待公益律师与医疗专业人员复核。

title.en: What to Do After Sexual Violence
title.zh: 性侵害发生后可以怎么做

tagline.en: Earlier care may preserve more options, but washing, changing clothes, delayed disclosure, alcohol, freezing, or incomplete memory never make it your fault or erase every path to help.
tagline.zh: 越早获得医疗帮助和了解取证选择，越有可能保留更多信息；但即使已经洗澡、换衣、过去很久、饮酒后记忆不完整或当时僵住，仍然可以寻求帮助、咨询或报案。这些情况都不是受害者的责任。

intro.en: This scenario starts after sexual violence and never depicts the assault. You can practise four situations: immediately afterwards, after washing or delay, supporting a friend, or dealing with incomplete memory. Medical and legal procedures vary locally, and no choice guarantees filing, prosecution, or conviction.
intro.zh: 这个情景从性侵害发生后开始，不呈现侵害过程。你可以练习四种情况：刚刚发生、已经洗澡或过了一段时间、支持朋友，以及饮酒或创伤导致记忆不完整。医疗和法律程序存在地区差异，任何选择都不能保证立案、起诉或定罪。

narration.en: Which situation do you want to practise?

coach.en: There is no single “perfect survivor” response. Safety and urgent medical needs come first; evidence is a possible chain of records, not one perfect item.
coach.zh: 不存在唯一“正确”的幸存者反应。应先处理安全和紧急医疗需要；证据可能由多项记录形成链条，而不是依赖某一件“完美物证”。

text.en: It just happened
text.zh: 事情刚刚发生

text.en: I already washed, changed clothes, or time has passed
text.zh: 已经洗澡、换衣，或过去了一段时间

text.en: A friend has told me what happened
text.zh: 朋友向我讲述了自己的经历

text.en: Memory is incomplete because of alcohol, sleep, fear, or trauma
text.zh: 因为饮酒、睡眠、恐惧或创伤，记忆并不完整

narration.en: The person has left, but you do not know whether they may return. You are in pain and your thoughts feel scattered.
narration.zh: 对方已经离开，但你不知道是否会回来。你感到不适，思绪也很混乱。

coach.en: Move toward immediate safety and urgent care first. If there is danger, call 110; for urgent medical needs, call 120 or go to a medical facility. You do not need to make every legal decision now.
coach.zh: 先确保即时安全并处理紧急医疗需要。如有危险可拨打 110；有紧急医疗需要可拨打 120 或前往医疗机构。你不需要现在一次做完所有法律决定。

text.en: Move to a safe place and contact emergency services
text.zh: 转移到安全地点并联系紧急服务

text.en: Call a trusted person to come or stay on the phone
text.zh: 请可信任的人赶来或保持通话

text.en: I freeze and cannot decide what to do
text.zh: 我僵住了，无法决定怎么办

feedback.en: Freezing is an automatic survival response, not consent and not a failure.
feedback.zh: 僵住可能是自动发生的求生反应，不等于同意，也不是你的失败。

narration.en: Once immediate danger is addressed, you can ask what medical care and evidence-preservation options exist locally.
narration.zh: 即时危险缓解后，你可以询问本地有哪些医疗和证据保存选项。

coach.en: Procedures, time windows, available examinations, and whether police involvement is required vary by place and facility. Ask what care is available, what consent is needed, how samples or records are handled, and what costs or referrals apply.
coach.zh: 不同地区和机构的程序、时间窗口、可提供的检查，以及是否需要警方介入都可能不同。可询问能提供哪些医疗、需要何种同意、样本或记录如何处理，以及费用和转诊安排。

text.en: Seek medical care and ask about local evidence-preservation choices
text.zh: 就医，并询问本地证据保存选项

text.en: Wash or change clothes because that is what I need to feel safe
text.zh: 为了让自己感觉安全，先洗澡或换衣

feedback.en: This does not make the event your fault and does not erase every other source of information or support.
feedback.zh: 这不会让事件变成你的责任，也不会抹去所有其他信息来源或求助路径。

text.en: Pause and decide later
text.zh: 先暂停，之后再决定

narration.en: You are worried that washing, changing clothes, or waiting means no one can help or believe you.
narration.zh: 你担心洗澡、换衣或延迟之后，就再也无法求助，也不会有人相信。

coach.en: You can still seek medical care, counselling, legal information, or report. Courts have considered combined records such as messages, calls, rides, CCTV, witnesses, prompt disclosures, hospital records, scene information, identifications, and biological evidence where available.
coach.zh: 你仍可以就医、寻求心理或法律支持，也可以报案。裁判文书显示，可结合聊天、通话、网约车记录、监控、证人、及时告知亲友的记录、病历、现场信息、辨认以及条件允许时的生物物证形成证据链。

text.en: Seek medical care for health needs and ask what can still be documented
text.zh: 为健康需要就医，并询问现在还能记录什么

text.en: Contact a support or legal service before deciding whether to report
text.zh: 在决定是否报案前，先联系支持或法律服务

text.en: Make a report even though time has passed
text.zh: 即使过去了一段时间，仍选择报案

narration.en: You remember fragments: a place, a message, a ride, waking up, and whom you contacted — but not a complete timeline.
narration.zh: 你只记得一些片段：地点、一条消息、一段行程、醒来时的情况，以及联系过谁，却拼不出完整时间线。

coach.en: Inability to resist, freezing, intoxication, sleep, fragmented memory, delayed disclosure, or lack of visible injury does not equal consent. Say what you remember, what you do not remember, and what records might fill gaps; do not guess to create a neat story.
coach.zh: 无法反抗、僵住、醉酒、睡眠、记忆片段化、延迟披露或没有明显伤痕，都不等于同意。可以如实区分“记得”“不记得”和“可能由哪些记录补充”，不要为了完整而猜测。

text.en: Write only what I remember and mark every uncertainty
text.zh: 只记录确实记得的内容，并标注所有不确定之处

text.en: Ask a trusted person to help collect existing records without filling in my memory
text.zh: 请可信任的人协助收集现有记录，但不替我补充记忆

text.en: Wait until every detail returns before seeking any help
text.zh: 等所有细节都想起来以后再求助

feedback.en: A complete timeline is not a prerequisite for medical, emotional, or legal information.
feedback.zh: 获得医疗、情绪或法律信息，并不要求先恢复完整时间线。

narration.en: Several independent records may exist even where your memory is incomplete.
narration.zh: 即使记忆不完整，也可能存在多项相互独立的记录。

text.en: Preserve chats, calls, SOS records, ride or order history, location history, and likely CCTV locations
text.zh: 保存聊天、通话、SOS 记录、行程或订单、位置记录及可能的监控地点

text.en: List people who saw me before or after, or whom I contacted soon afterwards
text.zh: 列出事发前后见过我或很快收到我消息的人

narration.en: Your friend says: “Something happened. I don't know what to do.”
narration.zh: 朋友说：“发生了一些事。我不知道该怎么办。”

coach.en: A helpful first response is: believe, do not blame, listen without demanding details, ask what support is wanted, protect privacy, and avoid taking control.
coach.zh: 更有帮助的第一反应是：相信、不责备、不逼问细节，询问对方需要什么支持，保护隐私，并避免替对方接管决定。

text.en: Say: “I believe you. This is not your fault. What would help right now?”
text.zh: 说：“我相信你。这不是你的错。你现在希望我怎么支持你？”

text.en: Ask for a detailed account so I can decide whether it was serious
text.zh: 要求对方讲清全部细节，由我判断是否严重

feedback.en: The survivor does not need to persuade you before receiving care and respect.
feedback.zh: 幸存者不需要先说服你，才有资格获得照顾和尊重。

text.en: Call the suspected offender and demand an explanation
text.zh: 直接联系涉嫌侵害者，要求对方解释

feedback.en: Confrontation can change safety, privacy, and evidence risks and may take control away from the survivor.
feedback.zh: 擅自对质可能改变安全、隐私和证据风险，也可能夺走幸存者的决定权。

narration.en: Your friend asks what options exist, but has not decided what to do.
narration.zh: 朋友想知道有哪些选择，但还没有决定下一步。

coach.en: Offer options without pressure: immediate safety, medical care, evidence information, police, legal advice, psychological support, social work, or simply company. Do not disclose the experience to others without permission, except where a specific legal duty requires action.
coach.zh: 可以不带压力地提供选项：即时安全、医疗、证据信息、报警、法律咨询、心理支持、社工服务，或只是陪伴。未经同意不要向他人泄露经历；特定法律义务要求采取行动的情形除外。

text.en: Offer to accompany them to care, police, or a support service if they choose
text.zh: 如果对方愿意，提供就医、报案或前往支持机构的陪同

text.en: Help make a written option list and let them choose the pace
text.zh: 帮助整理书面选项清单，由对方决定节奏

text.en: Tell family members so they can force a decision
text.zh: 告诉家人，让他们推动对方尽快决定

narration.en: You can make a simple map of possible records without forcing yourself to reconstruct everything at once.
narration.zh: 你可以简单列出可能存在的记录，不必逼自己一次重建全部经过。

coach.en: Possible corroboration includes messages and calls, rides and orders, CCTV locations, witnesses, SOS calls, medical records, clothing or scene information where safely available, and people told soon afterwards. Availability and evidentiary value vary.
coach.zh: 可能的相互印证材料包括聊天和通话、行程和订单、监控地点、证人、SOS 呼叫、病历、安全情况下可保存的衣物或现场信息，以及事后很快获知情况的人。材料是否存在、证明力如何都需个案判断。

text.en: Preserve existing digital records and note possible witnesses or CCTV locations
text.zh: 保存现有数字记录，并记下可能的证人或监控地点

text.en: Ask a trusted person to help organise records while keeping originals unchanged
text.zh: 请可信任的人协助整理记录，同时保持原始材料不变

text.en: Do not collect records now; seek emotional support first
text.zh: 现在先不整理记录，先寻求情绪支持

narration.en: You now have some information about available records. Reporting remains a separate decision.
narration.zh: 你已经了解了一些可能存在的记录。是否报案仍然是另一项决定。

coach.en: Unless a mandatory-reporting rule applies, reporting is the survivor's choice. You may seek legal information before deciding. If you report, distinguish memory from records and ask for written proof that the report was received.
coach.zh: 除非特定法律强制报告规则适用，是否报案原则上由幸存者决定。决定前可以先咨询法律信息。报案时应区分个人记忆和客观记录，并索要受理报案的书面凭证。

text.en: Make a report and bring the record map
text.zh: 携带记录清单报案

text.en: Talk to 12348 or a lawyer before deciding
text.zh: 决定前先咨询 12348 或律师

text.en: Do not report now and keep the records securely
text.zh: 现在不报案，先安全保存记录

narration.en: At the police station, an officer takes your account and asks about possible records and witnesses.
narration.zh: 在公安机关，工作人员记录你的陈述，并询问可能存在的记录和证人。

coach.en: Review the transcript before signing, correct wording that changes your meaning, and say clearly when something is unknown or uncertain. Ask what receipt or written decision the procedure provides and how to submit additional material. An admission by the accused is not the only possible proof; evidence is assessed together.
coach.zh: 签字前核对笔录，更正改变原意的措辞，并明确指出哪些内容“不知道”或“不确定”。询问程序可提供何种回执或书面决定，以及如何补交材料。对方是否承认不是唯一证明方式，证据应当综合审查。

text.en: Review and correct the transcript, then ask for a receipt or written record
text.zh: 核对并更正笔录，再索要回执或书面记录

text.en: Submit the record map and ask how to preserve time-sensitive CCTV or platform data
text.zh: 提交记录清单，并询问如何及时保存监控或平台数据

text.en: Sign quickly even though parts of the wording are inaccurate
text.zh: 即使部分表述不准确，也快速签字

title.zh: 你练习了以幸存者为中心的支持

summary.en: Believe, do not blame, listen without demanding details, ask what help is wanted, protect privacy, and remain patient. Accompaniment is helpful when it follows the survivor's choice rather than replacing it.
summary.zh: 相信、不责备、不逼问细节，询问需要、保护隐私并保持耐心。陪同只有在尊重幸存者选择时才是支持，而不是替对方做主。

title.zh: 你先选择了支持与稳定

summary.en: Seeking emotional or psychological support before making other decisions is valid. You may return to medical, legal, evidence, or reporting options later; no delay makes the violence your responsibility.
summary.zh: 在做其他决定前先获得情绪或心理支持是正当选择。之后仍可重新了解医疗、法律、证据或报案选项；延迟不会让暴力变成你的责任。

title.en: You kept the decision informed and open
title.zh: 你保留了知情决定的空间

summary.en: Legal information and secure record preservation can help without forcing an immediate report. Procedures and time limits vary, so ask a qualified local service about the options that apply to your facts.
summary.zh: 法律信息和安全保存记录可以帮助你，而不必强迫立即报案。程序与期限可能不同，应向本地合格服务了解适用于具体事实的选项。

title.en: A report begins a process, not a guaranteed outcome
title.zh: 报案启动的是程序，而不是保证结果

summary.en: Keep receipts and written decisions, preserve originals, submit additional records through traceable channels, and ask about review or legal-support options if a decision is unclear or disputed. Filing, investigation, prosecution, and conviction depend on the evidence and procedure in the case.
summary.zh: 保留回执和书面决定，保存原件，通过可追踪渠道补交材料；如决定不清楚或有争议，可询问复核和法律支持选项。受案、立案、侦查、起诉和定罪都取决于个案证据与程序。

title.zh: 你优先处理了即时安全

detail.en: Move away from immediate danger and address urgent medical needs first. Evidence should never take priority over survival or emergency care.
detail.zh: 先远离即时危险并处理紧急医疗需要。证据永远不应优先于生存与急救。

title.en: You asked what local medical and evidence options actually exist
title.zh: 你核实了本地实际可用的医疗与取证选项

detail.en: Ask the facility what care, examinations, consent, sample handling, records, referrals, and police involvement apply locally. Do not rely on a universal fixed-hour rule.
detail.zh: 向机构询问本地适用的医疗、检查、同意、样本处理、记录、转诊和警方介入要求，不要依赖一个全国统一的固定小时数。

title.zh: 你识别了可能相互印证的记录

detail.en: Chats, calls, rides, orders, location history, SOS records, CCTV locations, and platform records may help reconstruct events. Preserve originals and note where records are held.
detail.zh: 聊天、通话、行程、订单、位置、SOS、监控地点和平台记录可能帮助还原事件。应保存原始记录，并注明材料由谁或哪个平台持有。

basis.en: The reviewed judgments used combinations of digital, witness, scene, medical, identification, and biological evidence rather than one universal decisive item.
basis.zh: 本次查阅的裁判文书使用了数字记录、证人、现场、医疗、辨认和生物物证等多项组合，而不是依赖一项全国通用的决定性证据。

title.en: You mapped people who may corroborate the timeline
title.zh: 你列出了可能印证时间线的人

detail.en: People who saw you before or after, received a call or message, drove you, worked at the location, or heard a prompt disclosure may hold relevant independent information.
detail.zh: 事发前后见过你、收到通话或消息、提供出行服务、在场所工作，或较早获知情况的人，都可能掌握独立相关信息。

title.zh: 你区分了记忆与不确定内容

detail.en: Accurately saying “I do not remember” is better than guessing. Fragmented memory after fear, trauma, sleep, or intoxication does not equal consent.
detail.zh: 如实说“不记得”比猜测更准确。恐惧、创伤、睡眠或醉酒后的记忆片段化不等于同意。

detail.en: “I believe you. This is not your fault. What support do you want?” reduces pressure and returns choice to the survivor.
detail.zh: “我相信你。这不是你的错。你希望我怎么支持？”能减少压力，并把选择权还给幸存者。

title.en: You checked the transcript before signing
title.zh: 你在签字前核对了笔录

detail.en: Correct wording that changes your meaning and mark uncertainty accurately. Ask how corrections, additions, receipts, and later submissions are handled.
detail.zh: 更正改变原意的表述，并准确标明不确定内容。询问更正、补充、回执和后续提交材料的处理方式。

title.en: You asked for a traceable written record
title.zh: 你索要了可追踪的书面记录

detail.en: Keep any receipt, notice, contact information, and submission list you receive. Ask what written decision and review route apply if authorities decline to proceed.
detail.zh: 保存收到的回执、通知、联系方式和提交清单。如有关机关不继续处理，应询问适用的书面决定和复核渠道。

title.en: Support does not require a full retelling
title.zh: 提供支持不要求先完整复述

detail.en: Ask only what is needed for immediate safety and care. Let trained professionals ask relevant questions in the appropriate setting, and avoid making the survivor repeatedly prove the experience.
detail.zh: 只询问即时安全与照护所必需的信息。让受过训练的专业人员在适当场合询问相关问题，避免要求幸存者反复证明经历。

title.en: Unplanned confrontation can create new risks
title.zh: 未经计划的对质可能带来新风险

detail.en: Contact can change safety, retaliation, privacy, and evidence risks. Do not confront on the survivor's behalf without consent; seek professional advice where needed.
detail.zh: 联系对方可能改变安全、报复、隐私和证据风险。未经幸存者同意，不要代为对质；必要时先寻求专业意见。

title.en: Disclosure without consent can cause secondary harm
title.zh: 未经同意披露可能造成二次伤害

detail.en: Protect privacy and let the survivor decide who is told, except where a specific legal duty requires action. Family pressure is not a substitute for informed choice.
detail.zh: 保护隐私，原则上由幸存者决定告诉谁；特定法律义务要求采取行动的情形除外。家庭施压不能代替知情选择。

title.en: Inaccurate wording should be corrected before signing
title.zh: 不准确表述应在签字前更正

detail.en: Read the record carefully, request corrections, and distinguish fact, uncertainty, and information learned from records or others.
detail.zh: 仔细阅读记录，要求更正，并区分亲身记忆、不确定内容，以及从记录或他人处获知的信息。

realFlow.en: Immediate safety and urgent care — move away from danger; call 110 for immediate threat and 120 for urgent medical need.
realFlow.zh: 即时安全与急救——远离危险；存在即时威胁拨打 110，有紧急医疗需要拨打 120。

realFlow.en: Medical information — ask a local qualified facility what care, examinations, consent, timing, records, sample handling, and referrals are available.
realFlow.zh: 医疗信息——向本地合格机构询问可用医疗、检查、同意、时间、记录、样本处理和转诊安排。

realFlow.en: Possible evidence map — messages, calls, rides and orders, location history, SOS records, CCTV locations, witnesses, medical records, scene or clothing where safely available, and prompt disclosures.
realFlow.zh: 可能的证据清单——聊天、通话、行程订单、位置、SOS、监控地点、证人、病历、安全情况下的现场或衣物，以及较早向他人的告知。

realFlow.en: Support — ask a trusted person, 12338, 12348, social worker, counsellor, lawyer, or medical professional for the kind of help you want.
realFlow.zh: 支持——可向可信任的人、12338、12348、社工、心理人员、律师或医务人员提出你需要的帮助。

realFlow.en: If reporting — distinguish memory from uncertainty, review the transcript before signing, ask for a receipt or written decision, and keep a list of submitted material.
realFlow.zh: 如选择报案——区分记忆与不确定内容，签字前核对笔录，索要回执或书面决定，并保留材料提交清单。

realFlow.en: Follow-up — preserve originals, submit additions through traceable channels, and ask qualified local counsel about review or support routes. Do not assume any outcome is guaranteed.
realFlow.zh: 后续——保存原件，通过可追踪渠道补交材料，并向本地合格法律服务了解复核或支持路径。不要把任何结果视为必然。

note.en: Different records may support or test parts of an account together. No single type is universally required or automatically decisive.
note.zh: 不同记录可以共同支持或检验陈述中的部分事实。不存在全国通用、必不可少或自动决定结果的单一证据类型。

note.en: A call, message, or conversation soon after an event may become relevant witness or digital evidence. Delayed disclosure is also common and does not imply consent or fabrication.
note.zh: 事后较早发生的通话、消息或谈话，可能成为相关证人或数字证据。延迟披露同样常见，不意味着同意或虚构。

note.en: Automatic survival responses under threat. They are not consent and do not require visible resistance to be real.
note.zh: 威胁下自动发生的求生反应，不等于同意，也不要求必须出现可见反抗才真实。

note.en: Written proof of receipt or an official decision can help track what was submitted and identify applicable review routes. The exact document depends on the procedure used.
note.zh: 受理凭证或正式书面决定有助于追踪已提交事项并识别可用复核路径。具体文书取决于所适用的程序。
